title: schema_at_least and cmd_migrate_schema now coerce schema_version through to_int before bash arithmetic, closing the second injection sink

cmd_update_patterns was rewritten onto with_state_lock and write_atomic but the prescribed insertion tests were never added -- the only case still passes on a no-op implementation and still resolves the pattern file from committed plugin source

the hardcoded sed -n 2,45p help range is gone from edm-check-grants, run-eval.sh and score-artifacts.sh; all nine helpers plus the three evals scripts now use EDM-HELP-BEGIN/END sentinels with an awk extractor, and edm-init and edm-validate-prefix have help blocks
test:smoke-bash32 now runs apk add --no-cache jq git on the Alpine-based bash:3.2 image and asserts the running bash is 3.2 before invoking the suite

three CI status captures and the containment status capture are fixed, but the containment check still slices path=${line:3} so a porcelain rename record R old -> new whose destination escapes SRD/ is scored as contained
the class-2 PCRE branch now reads two fields from grep -n, so code-fence and edm-lint-ignore suppression is operative for the unicode class on the GNU-grep branch CI takes

the class-4 escape-valve comment now correctly states that the mermaid scan filters on EDM_MARKER_SET rather than the ignored set, matching the code at :345 and :363 (L1 half of CA-017; the header/budget prose halves belong to L6)
the three die messages regained their PREFIX, INIT_DIR and PATH_ARG interpolations and the remediation line now reads edm-state init ${PREFIX}
the closure message now reads prior_verdict from .verdict // .prior.verdict, so a PASS or FAIL entry closed later is no longer reported as was PARTIAL
audit-round-start now normalises --lenses first with || true and dies with a named message when the result is empty, so a degenerate value no longer aborts under pipefail with no diagnostic
compute_cost_usd binds -v orr= instead of the gawk-reserved built-in name or, so phase-complete and audit-round-complete no longer fail fatally on a gawk host

command substitution strips the pattern entry's trailing newline and _splice_pattern_file writes it with printf '%s', so multi-entry appends lose the blank line before every ### after the first and the last entry is concatenated onto the line at insert_line -- destroying a ## heading whenever the target section has no blank line before the next section boundary

write_atomic captures ec=$? directly after "$@" > "$tmp" and after mv under set -e, so it is correct only because all five current call sites sit in errexit-suspended positions; a bare call aborts the process instead of returning, and the one bare call at :1337 runs inside the flock subshell where suspension propagation is implementation-dependent

a present-but-non-integer schema_version is coerced to 0, passes the [[ -n ]] guard, does not trip the -le refusal, and is silently stamped down to 1 -- inverting the comment at :1945-1948 and contradicting the never-lowers-schema_version contract at :1915

the first two get-coverage jq renderers lack the || true fallback their two siblings at :1879 and :1888 carry, so an unparseable state file that passes the [[ -f ]] guard aborts the command under set -e with no message because jq's diagnostic is already sent to /dev/null

the lint:file-type-ban over-budget message ends in a colon promising the offending-file listing that every sibling message in the file prints, then exits 1 without printing anything, so a contributor is told evals/ is over budget but not what grew
em dashes in bin/tests/ remain, still correctly carved out by vocabulary-allowlist.txt:25-28 and unreachable by any lint invocation; the stdout residue stays CA-079
pattern_target_heading_for still ignores its argument and always returns the default heading -- documented at :3585-3592 as the intentional extension point coupled to a README mapping row
has_tool still word-splits $list unquoted under IFS=',' with an explicit shellcheck disable at :184; safe for every value on disk since no tool token matches a pathname and nullglob is off
git rev-parse --verify is still not qualified to refs/heads/, pre-existing and unreachable for the branch names this script generates

an edm-lint-ignore-end inside a fence still closes the ignore block and its own line is emitted in no class because the next at :62 precedes the in-fence ignored emission at :65; moved file, same behaviour, same unreachability
